page.overview:
Who is Omar Barker?

Omar Barker is character in (2018), (2021) and (2022), played by Omar Dorsey.

Sheriff Barker is a colleague of officer Frank Hawkins in the Warren County sheriff's office in Haddonfield, Illinois. Barker finds out that Michael Myers is loose on Halloween, but laughs at the notion of canceling the annual festivities in town. He tries to calm the people, but loses control of the hysteria in the crowd as they chase an innocent person to his death.

Four years later, in 2022, he gets word that Michael Myers has been killed and comes to the scene. The people want to do something, and he says that that night is the night to do it. He and his deputies escort the townsfolk to the town crusher in a night procession, where he, along with everyone else present, witnesses Laurie Strode and Allyson Nelson crush Michael's body in an industrial shredder.
